messages:
ara: Heads up — CI alert: multiple SCIM deprovision jobs are failing for a handful of tenants since ~09:42 UTC. Getting 500s from idp-redwood-prod when fetching SAML metadata. Audit pipeline shows missing correlation_id on ~30% of auth events. @oncall? :eyes:

maria: on it. did we have any KMS alias rotations this week? missing correlation_id sounds like an envelope unwrap issue or logging middleware crash.

kevin: we rotated the extid KMS alias in staging Tue (partial), prod rotation was scheduled but aborted — no full rollout. I can double-check the rotation logs.

samir: FYI I saw a POST /scim/Users deprovision return 502 then 500 in the same window. grabbing the raw response now.

jess: tagging product owners for affected tenants. Are we confident the IDP itself isn't returning malformed XML? Could be metadata fetch failing before we hit KMS.

kevin: pasted one raw fetch response from idp host: ```HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2025 09:42:18 GMT
Content-Type: application/xml
Server: idp-redwood-prod/2.1

<error>metadata fetch failed: server-side key unwrap error: envelope mismatch</error>```

maria: that text matches a KMS unwrap stacktrace on our side. Can you grep prod KMS logs for request ids around 09:42? Look for AliasChange or AccessDenied entries.

kevin: grep shows handful of UnwrapRSAKey errors at 09:42:17 from service-account svc-scim (role: scim/runner). Also one line: "AliasNotFoundException: alias/aws/extid-old" — looks like some requests still reference old alias.

ara: aha. So some workers had config pointing to alias-extid-old while others to alias-extid-new. That would cause mixed envelope keys -> unwrap fails -> idp returns 500 before we can log correlation_id.

samir: that also explains gap in audit pipeline — middleware crashed before correlation_id was assigned. Need postmortem on how alias config propagated inconsistently across autoscaled pods.

jess: immediate remediation? Can we flip a fallback to accept either alias for unwrap on the KMS side or reintroduce the old alias as a mirror?

maria: two quick options: 1) re-create alias/aws/extid-old pointing to the new CMK (fast, low-risk) so unwrap succeeds; 2) restart scim workers after ensuring env points to new alias (slower but cleaner). I vote 1 for immediate recovery.

kevin: I can recreate alias in KMS now. Doing it in 2 regions. Noting: must file ticket to track alias lifecycle.

deploy-bot: deployment 2025-03-12T09:50:02Z: rolling restart of scim-workers initiated by kevin.

maria: recreating alias... done in us-west-2. Monitoring logs for unwrap errors.

kevin: after alias recreation, 500 -> 200 ratio for SCIM deprovision dropped to normal within two minutes. audit pipeline started receiving correlation_id again.

ara: great. Follow-ups: - postmortem on how alias env var propagated (autoscaler hooks?) - add canary check to detect mixed-alias unwrap errors (alert if Unwrap* spikes) - update runbook to prefer alias recreation as short-term fallback.

samir: adding vuln/ops note: inconsistent key reference could be used in an attacker scenario to cause a denial-of-service against provisioning — mark as sev3 until mitigated.

jess: I'll notify affected customers with a brief incident note and timeline.

maria: also double-check our audit logging middleware to ensure correlation_id assignment happens earlier in the request path so downstream failures don't drop it.

kevin: created infra ticket INFRA-3421 to block alias deletion until all worker revisions confirm new alias.

ara: thanks all. I'll start the incident doc with timeline and add the suggested action items. Closing thread when doc links up. :white_check_mark:
